cards.title: Implemented target authentication
items: IMPLEMENTED IN SOURCE / GATED A — Entra tokens go directly to LiteLLM; it validates issuer, audience, JWKS and CCGC.Access, uses oid for identity and virtual_key_claim_field, and rejects unmapped oid with 403. Verified enrollment POSTs mapping new/update; revoke disables the mapping before the CCGC binding.

cards.title: Feature + enterprise compatibility
items: SUPPORTED A/B — Copilot per-user OAuth, Anthropic Messages/Claude Code, Chat, Responses, Embeddings, aliases and GHE.com; the mapped LiteLLM user owns the GitHub connection. Enterprise Entra/OIDC, SCIM, JWT mapping, virtual keys, logs/audit, groups/catalog, API clients, expiry, budgets, rates and spend remain.

cards.title: Compatibility paths + production gate
items: B — admissions/API keys stay in ccgc_litellm_auth; identity match, revision grants, stale invalidation, correlation and Desktop automation remain custom. CLI SSO is beta; apiKeyHelper is supported. NOT DEPLOYED: activation requires LiteLLM enterprise licensing and live parity verification; sources are repository code and LiteLLM provider/JWT/identity/CLI/audit docs.
